correctness.rationale: Legal square sets form the ordinary independence complex of the queen attack graph. Independent complete enumeration found 462 faces including empty, f-by-cardinality (1,25,140,204,82,10). Greedy pivot matching over all 25 square labels found exactly 222 pairs, leaving one critical edge and seventeen critical triangles with empty simplex matched. The independently reconstructed directed Hasse graph has 462 vertices and 1295 incidences and topological sort verified no directed cycle. Exact integer projection through matched edges found all seventeen critical 2-cell attaching degrees zero; a reduced Morse CW model with one loop and seventeen trivial 2-attachments has integral homotopy S1 vee 17 S2. Boundary vanishing, not merely rational homology, supports the wedge.
